nodes.title: RAG_BASED_AI
nodes.blurb: A fully offline Retrieval-Augmented QA pipeline that turns course videos into a searchable knowledge base.
chunks: Answers natural-language questions grounded strictly in retrieved transcript context, with no external APIs — every model runs locally.
The end-to-end flow chains ffmpeg audio extraction, timestamped Whisper transcription, chunking, and embedding generation via a local bge-m3 model.
Retrieval is a top-k scan over cosine similarity against 1024-dimensional dense vectors.
Chunk size and overlap were tuned against a manually labelled question set, so retrieval quality was measured rather than assumed.
Only the highest-scoring chunks reach a local deepseek-r1 LLM through Ollama, with prompts constraining every answer to a cited video title and timestamp.
A crash that surfaced only at full corpus scale was root-caused by profiling embedding batch sizes and fixed by restructuring requests into chunked batches.
metrics: tuned against a labelled question set

nodes.title: Superstore Profitability Analysis
nodes.blurb: A SQL and Power BI investigation into whether a retailer's margin problem came from product mix or from pricing.
chunks: Across 9,994 transactions covering $2.3M revenue and 793 customers, SQL bucketing showed margin holds at 29.5% undiscounted.
Margin turns negative past a 25% discount and reaches −77% beyond 40%, converting a vague concern into a specific policy threshold.
The pattern was validated independently at sub-category, region, category and customer level rather than accepted from a single cut.
Window-function and CTE queries covered year-over-year growth, cohort retention and RFM segmentation.
Delivered as an interactive Power BI dashboard with DAX measures and cross-filtering, alongside a recommendation worth an estimated $35K in recoverable annual profit.

nodes.title: Video Caption Maker
nodes.blurb: A production SaaS platform that puts a speech-to-text ML workload behind a real service.
chunks: GPU-accelerated Whisper transcription runs on Celery workers so long-running inference never blocks the API.
ChromaDB holds vector representations of the generated transcripts for semantic search over captions.
The system spans six Docker Compose services: a Next.js 14 frontend, FastAPI backend, Celery workers, Redis, PostgreSQL and ChromaDB.
The data layer is async SQLAlchemy with Alembic migrations.
Security was designed in from the first commit — httpOnly JWT cookies, bcrypt hashing, a CORS policy and upload validation, with auth built before the upload path existed.

nodes.title: PactPal
nodes.blurb: An NLP contract-analysis platform that rewrites dense legal language into plain English for non-expert readers.
chunks: Text processing and summarisation models drive the pipeline end to end.
Measured reading time dropped by roughly 30% for the users it was tested with — a usability gain quantified against real documents rather than estimated.
The reader-facing layer is a React frontend over a Python NLP backend.

nodes.title: ATW Mobile — Driver & Medic
nodes.blurb: A driver and medic coordination app shipped to a logistics client in Cairo, built around real-time GPS telemetry.
chunks: Full trip-lifecycle event data — request, acceptance, live status, completion — is modelled into a clean, queryable operational record.
Real-time GPS telemetry streams are ingested with state kept consistent across concurrent users on a live database.
Post-trip EMS reporting modules enforce validation rules that protect data integrity across high-criticality logistics records.
Built with Flutter against Firebase and shipped to a real client.
